Neptune Laundry charges wash dry fold by the pound. There is no monthly plan, no membership and no commitment. You place an order when you need one and you pay for that order.

Pickup and delivery runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. Customers who schedule on a recurring basis pay a lower rate per pound than one time orders.

Does a laundry subscription feel like one more bill you do not want? This is not that. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Schedule a Friday pickup with Neptune Laundry and your laundry comes back folded without costing you a Saturday. That is the point of the service. You hand off the pile, you get the weekend.

Pickup and delivery runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. No sorting, any bag, and wash dry fold priced by the pound.

When you think about your next free Saturday, does laundry belong in it? Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry delivers laundry to fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. The route runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and it covers Boston, Cambridge, Chelsea, Everett, Malden, Medford, Melrose, Lynn, Lynnfield, Revere, Saugus, Stoneham, Wakefield and Winthrop.

If you live in one of those communities, you do not have to drive to a laundromat at all. We pick up at your door and bring your laundry back washed, dried and folded. Wash dry fold is priced by the pound and there is no subscription.

Is your city on that list? Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery was built for households that run out of hours before they run out of laundry. A family generates more laundry in a week than most weeknights can absorb. One pickup clears it.

The service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and covers fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. No sorting, any bag, priced by the pound, no subscription.

Is laundry the chore that keeps sliding to the next day in your house? Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Comforters, quilts and other bulky bedding are part of Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery. Comforter cleaning is priced by size, from regular through queen, king, feather and extra large, so a king comforter is not billed like a small one.

Home washers usually cannot handle a full comforter. Neptune uses ninety pound commercial washers, and the pickup service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA.

Has a comforter been sitting in your closet because it will not fit in your machine? Add it to a pickup order. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery covers wash, dry and fold. That includes everyday clothing, towels, sheets, comforters and other household laundry. Neptune does not offer dry cleaning, so garments that require it should go to a dry cleaner instead.

Being clear about the scope saves you a wasted trip. Everything else goes in the bag, unsorted, and comes back folded at your door. The service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA.

Have you ever handed off laundry and found out afterward what was not included? Not here. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry offers recurring pickup and delivery for customers who schedule regularly. Recurring orders are billed at a lower rate per pound than one time orders, and the pickup happens on the same rhythm each month without you rebooking it.

Recurring service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore.

Would laundry stop being a decision if it simply happened on schedule? Set it once. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry serves customers in English, Spanish and Portuguese. In East Boston, Chelsea, Everett and Lynn that matters, because arranging a service should not depend on which language you are most comfortable in.

Pickup and delivery runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. Any bag works, no sorting is needed, and wash dry fold is priced by the pound.

Have you ever avoided calling a business because of the language on the other end? Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Greater Boston moves on September first. The City of Boston calls it Moving Day, and most residential leases in the city turn over on that date, which makes the last stretch of August the busiest packing period of the year. Linens, towels and bedding are the worst things to pack dirty.

Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and covers fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. Send the soft goods out, pack the rest.

Is your move already on the calendar? Get the laundry out of the way first. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Move in season fills Greater Boston with students, and dorm bedding is the first thing that needs washing and the last thing anyone plans for. Comforters, mattress pads and sheet sets all fit in a Neptune Laundry pickup order.

The service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore, including Boston, Cambridge and Medford, where most campuses sit.

Moving into a place with no washer in the building? That is exactly who this is for. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Neptune Laundry washes every pickup and delivery order in its own facility. The laundry is not handed to a third party processor and it does not leave the company between your door and its return. It is washed at 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, by the same team that runs the store.

Neptune has operated in the Greater Boston area since 1999. Twenty five years of doing this in house is why the process stays consistent.

Do you actually know who is handling your clothes when you use a laundry app? Here you do. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.

Short term rental hosts in East Boston, Winthrop and downtown Boston run linens on a turnover clock. Neptune Laundry handles that volume through pickup and delivery, and commercial orders are priced per pound on negotiated terms rather than a fixed retail rate.

The route runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, minutes from Logan, and covers fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore.

Are your turnovers already tight without the laundry in them? Move it off your list. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android, or ask about a commercial account.

August humidity in Greater Boston is what makes towels smell before they are even dirty. Damp fabric sitting in a hamper builds odor fast, and a home dryer that never quite finishes the load makes it worse.

Commercial washers and dryers run hotter and finish the load completely. Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and reaches fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. Beach towels, gym clothes and everything else go in the same bag, unsorted.

Does your laundry smell fine coming out and stale by the next day? Schedule a pickup through the Neptune app and use code FIRST20 on a first order.
